Next's app router has two routes: app/page.tsx (/) and app/docs/page.tsx (/docs). The eight entries of the sidebar (components/sidebar.tsx, navItems) do not navigate: each calls onSectionChange and app/page.tsx renders that section in place, so each is captured as the page it is on screen, reached by pressing its button inside the aside. The sidebar exists only with a wallet connected (app/page.tsx: `connected && <Sidebar/>`), so those captures use the stand-in wallet. The disclaimer over the page is agreed to first, as it was for the first capture.
